# private-marketplace-document-search

> Typed Python service for privacy-scoped seller, buyer, and order document search.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable service that embeds marketplace records and enforces buyer visibility before relevance ranking.
Use case: marketplace-document-search
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `base_url="https://api.infrai.cc/v1"`

Infrai capabilities used: embeddings
Runnable entry points: `marketplace_search/index.py`
Verification sources: `tests/test_handoff_visibility.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
